title: Personal Checking: Refund Decision in the Same-Day Maintenance Fee Review
content:
## Decision rule

For a Personal Checking maintenance fee reviewed on its own cycle closing date, the relationship balance that the tier's relationship waiver is judged on is the combined deposit balance defined for that review, as it stands when business closes that day. Where the account's tier offers that waiver, it is met when the balance is at or above the relationship balance level the tier sets for it; a tier that does not offer it gives no waiver on this basis.

The fee under review is refunded when both of the following are true:

- at least one waiver judged in this review is met — the relationship waiver or any other waiver the review reads from the ledger, a single one being enough; and
- the fee carries no refund entry yet.

The refund is then the fee's own amount in full, never a part, recorded with bank error as its reason, because a fee charged although a waiver was met is a bank error. In every other case this review refunds nothing. The tier's other waivers, and any request for a goodwill refund, remain matters for the general Personal Checking maintenance fee and fee refund rules.

Fee amounts carry two decimals, so no rounding applies.

## Decision table

| Relationship waiver met | Another waiver judged here met | Fee already refunded | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | either | no | full fee |
| no | yes | no | full fee |
| no | no | no | none under this review |
| any | any | yes | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical tier level of 20000.00 USD)

- Balance measured at 20000.00 USD: exactly at the level, waiver met, fee refunded in full.
- Balance measured at 19999.99 USD with no other waiver met: no refund under this review.
